docs.title: Reusable Workflows
docs.text: Centralized, reusable GitHub Actions workflows for the infinite-automations organization.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
1. Centralize workflow maintenance — action updates, tests, and releases in one place
  2. Standardize CI/CD patterns across all repositories

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
# In your repository's .github/workflows/ci.yml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: ["main"]
  pull_request:
    branches: ["main"]

jobs:
  lint:
    uses: infinite-automations/workflows/.github/workflows/lint.yml@v1.0.0
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: read
      statuses: write

  release:
    needs: [lint]
    uses: infinite-automations/workflows/.github/workflows/release.yml@v1.0.0
    with:
      dry-run: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
    secrets: inherit
    permissions:
      contents: write
      issues: write
      pull-requests: write

docs.title: Available Workflows
docs.text: See the Workflows section for auto-generated documentation of all reusable workflows.

docs.title: GitHub Action Repository
docs.text:
A typical GitHub Action repository using composable workflows with custom tests:

name: Test & Release

on:
  push:
    branches: ["main"]
  pull_request:
    branches: ["main"]

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  lint:
    uses: infinite-automations/workflows/.github/workflows/lint.yml@v1.0.0
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: read
      statuses: write

  test:
    name: Test
    needs: [lint]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - name: "Test A"
            input-a: "value1"
          - name: "Test B"
            input-a: "value2"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Run Action
        uses: ./
        with:
          input-a: ${{ matrix.input-a }}

  docs:
    needs: [lint]
    uses: infinite-automations/workflows/.github/workflows/docs-action.yml@v1.0.0
    with:
      dry-run: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
    permissions:
      contents: write

  release:
    needs: [lint, test, docs]
    uses: infinite-automations/workflows/.github/workflows/release.yml@v1.0.0
    with:
      dry-run: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
      extra-plugins: |
        conventional-changelog-conventionalcommits
        semantic-release-major-tag
        semantic-release-replace-plugin
    secrets:
      APP_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_ID_SEMREL }}
      APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.APP_KEY_SEMREL }}
    permissions:
      contents: write
      issues: write
      pull-requests: write

docs.title: Terraform Module Repository
docs.text:
name: Test & Release

on:
  push:
    branches: ["main"]
  pull_request:
    branches: ["main"]

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  lint:
    uses: infinite-automations/workflows/.github/workflows/lint.yml@v1.0.0
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: read
      statuses: write

  test:
    name: Terraform Test
    needs: [lint]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && 'pr' || 'main' }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Terraform Apply
        # Your terraform test steps here
        run: echo "terraform apply"

  docs:
    needs: [lint]
    uses: infinite-automations/workflows/.github/workflows/docs-terraform.yml@v1.0.0
    with:
      dry-run: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
      working-dir: ".,bootstrap,examples/full"
    permissions:
      contents: write

  release:
    needs: [lint, test, docs]
    uses: infinite-automations/workflows/.github/workflows/release.yml@v1.0.0
    with:
      dry-run: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
    secrets:
      APP_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_ID_SEMREL }}
      APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.APP_KEY_SEMREL }}
    permissions:
      contents: write
      issues: write
      pull-requests: write

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• A GitHub repository in the infinite-automations organization
  • Workflows must be referenced by SHA or tag (enforced by linting)

docs.title: Step 1: Configure Linting
docs.text:
Create .github/linters/.super-linter.env in your repository:

# Enable the linters relevant to your project
VALIDATE_GITHUB_ACTIONS=true
VALIDATE_GITHUB_ACTIONS_ZIZMOR=true
VALIDATE_YAML=true

# For Terraform repos, add:
# VALIDATE_TERRAFORM_TFLINT=true
# VALIDATE_TERRAFORM_FMT=true

# For repos with shell scripts:
# VALIDATE_BASH=true

docs.title: Option A: Use Toplevel Workflow (Simple)
docs.text:
Best for repos without custom tests:

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: ["main"]
  pull_request:
    branches: ["main"]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  ci:
    uses: infinite-automations/workflows/.github/workflows/ci-action.yml@v1.0.0
    with:
      dry-run: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
    secrets: inherit

docs.title: Option B: Compose Baselines (Flexible)
docs.text:
Best for repos with custom tests:

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: ["main"]
  pull_request:
    branches: ["main"]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  lint:
    uses: infinite-automations/workflows/.github/workflows/lint.yml@v1.0.0
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: read
      statuses: write

  test:
    needs: [lint]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Your Tests
        run: echo "Run your tests here"

  release:
    needs: [lint, test]
    uses: infinite-automations/workflows/.github/workflows/release.yml@v1.0.0
    with:
      dry-run: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
    secrets: inherit
    permissions:
      contents: write
      issues: write
      pull-requests: write

docs.title: Step 3: Configure Semantic Release
docs.text:
Create .releaserc.json in your repository root:

{
  "branches": ["main"],
  "plugins": [
    ["@semantic-release/commit-analyzer", { "preset": "conventionalcommits" }],
    [
      "@semantic-release/release-notes-generator",
      { "preset": "conventionalcommits" }
    ],
    "@semantic-release/github"
  ]
}

docs.title: Step 4: Configure Renovate
docs.text:
Add renovate.json to keep dependencies updated:

{
  "$schema": "https://docs.renovatebot.com/renovate-schema.json",
  "extends": ["config:recommended", "helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests"],
  "automerge": true,
  "platformAutomerge": true
}

docs.title: Local Linting
docs.text: Run the same Super-Linter configuration locally using Docker.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• Docker installed and running
  • .github/linters/.super-linter.env configured

docs.title: Using the Script
docs.text:
# From the repository root
./scripts/lint-local.sh

docs.title: Using Docker Directly
docs.text:
docker run --rm \
  -e RUN_LOCAL=true \
  -e DEFAULT_BRANCH=main \
  --env-file .github/linters/.super-linter.env \
  -v "$(pwd):/tmp/lint" \
  ghcr.io/super-linter/super-linter:v8.6.0

docs.title: Configuration
docs.text:
The .github/linters/.super-linter.env file is shared between CI and local runs:

# Enable validators for your project
VALIDATE_GITHUB_ACTIONS=true
VALIDATE_GITHUB_ACTIONS_ZIZMOR=true
VALIDATE_YAML=true
VALIDATE_MARKDOWN=true

Linter-specific configuration files in .github/linters/ are also used:

File Linter actionlint.yml actionlint zizmor.yaml zizmor .yaml-lint.yml yamllint .tflint.hcl tflint .markdown-lint.yml markdownlint

docs.title: Build (.NET)
docs.text: Builds, tests, and publishes a .NET application with optional test reporting and artifact upload.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
jobs:
  build:
    uses: infinite-automations/workflows/.github/workflows/build-dotnet.yml@v1.0.0
    with:
      dotnet-version: "8.x"
      working-directory: src
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      checks: write

docs.title: Inputs
docs.text: Input Type Default Description dotnet-version string 8.x .NET SDK version to install working-directory string src Directory containing the .NET solution/project build-configuration string Release Build configuration publish-output string app Output directory for dotnet publish artifact-name string build Name prefix of the uploaded artifact test-reporter boolean true Enable test result reporting (requires checks: write)

docs.title: Outputs
docs.text: Output Description artifact-name Name of the uploaded build artifact status Build result: success or failure

docs.title: CD (Docker + Helm)
docs.text: Toplevel convenience workflow for deploying Docker images with Helm. Retags an existing image (built during CI) and deploys via Helm.

docs.title: Triggered by Release
docs.text:
name: Deploy

on:
  release:
    types: [released]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  deploy:
    uses: infinite-automations/workflows/.github/workflows/cd-docker-helm.yml@v1.0.0
    with:
      release-name: my-app
      chart: stakater/application
      chart-version: "5.2.3"
      namespace: production
      source-tag: sha-${{ github.sha }}
      tags: |
        ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}
        latest
      helm-repos: |
        stakater=https://stakater.github.io/stakater-charts
      values-files: |
        helm/common.yaml
      set-values: |
        deployment.image.tag=${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}
      deploy-environment: production
    secrets:
      KUBECONFIG: ${{ secrets.KUBECONFIG }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write

docs.title: With Explicit Source Tag
docs.text:
jobs:
  deploy:
    uses: infinite-automations/workflows/.github/workflows/cd-docker-helm.yml@v1.0.0
    with:
      source-tag: sha-abc1234
      release-name: my-app
      chart: stakater/application
      namespace: staging
      set-values: |
        deployment.image.tag=sha-abc1234

docs.title: Inputs
docs.text: Input Type Default Description dry-run boolean false Do not tag or deploy deploy-dry-run boolean false Tag normally but dry-run the deploy image string ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }} Image name tags string Newline-separated tags to apply source-tag string Source tag to retag from (auto-resolved if empty) tag-semver string {{version}} SemVer pattern for source resolution registry string ghcr.io Container registry oras-version string 1.2.2 ORAS CLI version release-name string required Helm release name chart string required Helm chart reference chart-version string Chart version namespace string default Kubernetes namespace create-namespace boolean true Create namespace if missing values-files string Helm values files set-values string --set key=value pairs helm-repos string Helm repos to add (name=url) deploy-environment string GitHub environment for protection deploy-runner string ubuntu-latest Runner label helm-registry string OCI registry for private charts

docs.title: Secrets
docs.text: Secret Required Description REGISTRY_USERNAME No Image registry username REGISTRY_PASSWORD No Image registry password HELM_REGISTRY_USERNAME No Private Helm chart registry username HELM_REGISTRY_PASSWORD No Private Helm chart registry password KUBECONFIG No Kubeconfig for cluster auth

docs.title: Outputs
docs.text: Output Description retag-tags Tags applied to image deploy-status Deploy result

docs.title: CI (Action)
docs.text:
Toplevel convenience workflow for GitHub Action repositories. Composes lint, docs, and release.

Custom Tests

This workflow does not include test jobs. Run your tests before calling this workflow, or compose from baseline workflows directly.

docs.title: Without Custom Tests
docs.text:
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: ["main"]
  pull_request:
    branches: ["main"]

jobs:
  ci:
    uses: infinite-automations/workflows/.github/workflows/ci-action.yml@v1.0.0
    with:
      dry-run: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
    secrets:
      APP_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_ID_SEMREL }}
      APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.APP_KEY_SEMREL }}

docs.title: With Custom Tests
docs.text:
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: ["main"]
  pull_request:
    branches: ["main"]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Run Tests
        uses: ./
        with:
          # your test inputs

  ci:
    needs: [test]
    uses: infinite-automations/workflows/.github/workflows/ci-action.yml@v1.0.0
    with:
      dry-run: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
    secrets: inherit

docs.title: CI (.NET)
docs.text:
Toplevel convenience workflow for .NET application repositories. Composes lint, build, Docker, and release.

Custom Tests

This workflow does not include custom test jobs beyond dotnet test. If you need additional integration tests, compose from baseline workflows directly.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: ["main"]
  pull_request:
    branches: ["main"]

jobs:
  ci:
    uses: infinite-automations/workflows/.github/workflows/ci-dotnet.yml@v1.0.0
    with:
      dry-run: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
      dotnet-version: "8.x"
      working-directory: src
      docker-context: src/MyApp
    secrets:
      APP_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_ID_SEMREL }}
      APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.APP_KEY_SEMREL }}
    permissions:
      contents: write
      issues: write
      packages: write
      pull-requests: write
      statuses: write
      actions: read
      checks: write

docs.title: Inputs
docs.text: Input Type Default Description dry-run boolean false Lint and build run normally, release is dry-run skip-lint boolean false Skip the lint job skip-docker boolean false Skip the Docker build job dotnet-version string 8.x .NET SDK version working-directory string . .NET solution/project directory build-configuration string Release Build configuration docker-image string ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }} Docker image name docker-context string . Docker build context docker-file string Dockerfile path docker-target string Docker build target stage semrel-extra-plugins string Extra semantic-release plugins

docs.title: Secrets
docs.text: Secret Required Description APP_ID No GitHub App ID for release auth APP_PRIVATE_KEY No GitHub App private key REGISTRY_USERNAME No Docker registry username REGISTRY_PASSWORD No Docker registry password

docs.title: Outputs
docs.text: Output Description lint-status Lint result build-status Build result docker-digest Docker image digest docker-tags Docker image tags version Released version published Whether a version was published

docs.title: Deploy (Helm)
docs.text: Deploys an application using Helm with optional OCI registry login and Kubernetes cluster authentication.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
jobs:
  deploy:
    uses: infinite-automations/workflows/.github/workflows/deploy-helm.yml@v1.0.0
    with:
      release-name: my-app
      chart: stakater/application
      chart-version: "5.2.3"
      namespace: production
      helm-repos: |
        stakater=https://stakater.github.io/stakater-charts
      values-files: |
        helm/common.yaml
      set-values: |
        deployment.image.tag=1.2.3
    secrets:
      KUBECONFIG: ${{ secrets.KUBECONFIG }}
    permissions:
      contents: read

docs.title: Inputs
docs.text: Input Type Default Description dry-run boolean false Run helm template instead of helm upgrade release-name string required Helm release name chart string required Chart reference (e.g. stakater/application) chart-version string Chart version constraint namespace string default Kubernetes namespace create-namespace boolean true Create namespace if missing values-files string Newline-separated list of values files set-values string Newline-separated key=value pairs for --set helm-repos string Newline-separated repos to add (name=url) environment string GitHub environment for deployment protection runner string ubuntu-latest Runner label registry string OCI registry for private charts

docs.title: Secrets
docs.text: Secret Required Description KUBECONFIG No Kubeconfig content for cluster auth REGISTRY_USERNAME No Username for private Helm chart registry REGISTRY_PASSWORD No Password for private Helm chart registry

docs.title: Outputs
docs.text: Output Description status Deploy result: success or failure

docs.title: Documentation (MkDocs)
docs.text: Builds a MkDocs site using Material for MkDocs. Optionally deploys to GitHub Pages via mkdocs gh-deploy when deploy-branch is set.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
Build only (e.g. for PRs):

jobs:
  docs:
    uses: infinite-automations/workflows/.github/workflows/docs-mkdocs.yml@v1.0.0
    with:
      dry-run: true
    permissions:
      contents: read

Build and deploy to GitHub Pages:

jobs:
  docs:
    uses: infinite-automations/workflows/.github/workflows/docs-mkdocs.yml@v1.0.0
    with:
      deploy-branch: gh-pages
    permissions:
      contents: write

docs.title: Inputs
docs.text: Input Type Default Description dry-run boolean false Build but do not deploy docs-dir string docs Directory containing mkdocs.yml python-version string 3.x Python version for MkDocs deploy-branch string "" Branch for mkdocs gh-deploy (empty = skip deploy) artifact-name string docs-site Artifact name for built site

docs.title: Outputs
docs.text: Output Description artifact-name Name of the uploaded artifact

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• A mkdocs.yml configuration file in the specified docs-dir
  • If deploying: GitHub Pages configured to serve from the deploy-branch

docs.title: Lint
docs.text: Lints your repository using Super-Linter.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
jobs:
  lint:
    uses: infinite-automations/workflows/.github/workflows/lint.yml@v1.0.0
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: read
      statuses: write

docs.title: Configuration
docs.text:
Create a .github/linters/.super-linter.env file in your repository to configure which linters to enable:

# Enable specific validators (unset ones default to false)
VALIDATE_GITHUB_ACTIONS=true
VALIDATE_GITHUB_ACTIONS_ZIZMOR=true
VALIDATE_YAML=true
VALIDATE_TERRAFORM_TFLINT=true
VALIDATE_BASH=true

This same file can be used for local linting with Docker.

Super-Linter also reads linter-specific config files from .github/linters/ (e.g., actionlint.yml, zizmor.yaml, .yaml-lint.yml).

docs.title: Inputs
docs.text: Input Type Default Description dry-run boolean false No effect for linting (always runs)

docs.title: Outputs
docs.text: Output Description status Lint result: success or failure

docs.title: OCI Retag
docs.text: Retags an existing OCI image using ORAS without rebuilding. Useful for promoting images from CI tags (branch/sha) to release tags (semver/latest).

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
jobs:
  retag:
    uses: infinite-automations/workflows/.github/workflows/oras-tag.yml@v1.0.0
    with:
      image: ghcr.io/my-org/my-app
      tags: |
        1.2.3
        latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write

docs.title: With Explicit Source Tag
docs.text:
When triggered by a release event, auto-resolution via docker/metadata-action may not find the correct source. Use source-tag to specify it explicitly:

jobs:
  retag:
    uses: infinite-automations/workflows/.github/workflows/oras-tag.yml@v1.0.0
    with:
      image: ghcr.io/my-org/my-app
      source-tag: sha-${{ github.sha }}
      tags: |
        ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}
        latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write

docs.title: Source Tag Resolution
docs.text:
When source-tag is not provided, docker/metadata-action resolves the source automatically using these tag types (first match wins):

  1. type=sha → commit SHA tag (e.g. sha-abc1234)
  2. type=ref,event=branch → branch name (e.g. main)
  3. type=ref,event=pr → PR number (e.g. pr-42)
  4. type=semver,pattern=... → SemVer from release tag

This works well for push and pull_request events. For release events, prefer setting source-tag explicitly to avoid ambiguity.

docs.title: Inputs
docs.text: Input Type Default Description dry-run boolean false Resolve and display but do not tag image string ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }} Full image name without tag source-tag string Source image tag to retag from (skips metadata-action if set) tag-semver string {{version}} SemVer pattern for source resolution (used when source-tag is not set) tags string Newline-separated list of new tags to apply registry string ghcr.io Container registry to authenticate with oras-version string 1.2.2 ORAS CLI version

docs.title: Secrets

docs.title: Release
docs.text:
Runs semantic-release via cycjimmy/semantic-release-action.

Supports authentication via GitHub App token (preferred) or GITHUB_TOKEN fallback.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
jobs:
  release:
    uses: infinite-automations/workflows/.github/workflows/release.yml@v1.0.0
    with:
      dry-run: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
    secrets:
      APP_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_ID_SEMREL }}
      APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.APP_KEY_SEMREL }}
    permissions:
      contents: write
      issues: write
      pull-requests: write

docs.title: For GitHub Actions
docs.text:
Pass semantic-release-major-tag and semantic-release-replace-plugin via extra-plugins to automatically update major version tags (v1, v2, …) and version references in documentation:

jobs:
  release:
    uses: infinite-automations/workflows/.github/workflows/release.yml@v1.0.0
    with:
      dry-run: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
      extra-plugins: |
        conventional-changelog-conventionalcommits
        semantic-release-major-tag
        semantic-release-replace-plugin
    secrets:
      APP_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_ID_SEMREL }}
      APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.APP_KEY_SEMREL }}
    permissions:
      contents: write
      issues: write
      pull-requests: write
